title: Main entrance vs whole station confusion
body: The key communications risk is confusion between “main entrance closed” and “station closed”.

title: Reputationally visible despite modest operational impact
body: The issue is operationally modest but reputationally visible during the morning peak.

title: Avoid speculation on roof drainage
body: Staff need a clear line to avoid speculation about roof drainage before facilities confirms.

title: Lead with what remains available
body: Passenger messaging should lead with what remains available: trains running, side entrance open.

title: Check accessibility separately
body: Accessibility impact should be checked separately, not assumed from general flow reports.

title: Future works handback focus
body: Later review should focus on handback criteria, temporary signage and pre-agreed passenger messaging for planned works.
